research_findings: Discovered that the existing Dashboard problem search relied on basic String.prototype.includes, which lacked typo tolerance and required exact substring matches.
Identified that fuse.js was already present in the project's package.json dependencies, making it an ideal candidate for introducing fuzzy search without bloating the bundle size.
Identified that fuse object instantiation directly within useMemo in React was an expensive anti-pattern during filtering because it could trigger frequent re-evaluations during typing.
features_improved: Refactored DashboardClient.tsx search filtering to utilize Fuse.js for fuzzy string matching across problem titles, tags, descriptions, and companies.
new_features_added: Introduced a new weighted fuzzy search for practice problems, prioritizing title and tags for highly relevant search results.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement a session dashboard to allow users to view all of their saved offline sessions, as noted in the SESSION_PERSISTENCE.md future enhancements section.
